**Please submit only one feature request in one issue!**  
If it is UI/UX related, don't post how a single aspect of the UI should be changed, rather in which use-case you felt
the UI is lacking or should be improved.

**Feature requests that were primarily generated by an LLM will not be accepted.**  
LLMs tend to create overly verbose prose, often go off on irrelevant tangents and mix high-level descriptions with
details that would take significant time to verify.
It is the duty of the person reporting a feature request to provide a description that can be parsed in reasonable
amount of time.
If maintainers suspect a feature request is created by an LLM without human verification and refinement they are free
to close it without further reason.


**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**  
A clear and concise description of what the problem is.

**Describe the solution you'd like**  
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**  
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional context**  
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
